newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end firm in erratic turnover.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end firm in erratic turnover.

text.p: Chilean stocks pulled back from early losses to close firmer, with the market tracking Wall Street as local investors digest recent company earnings, said traders.
The bolsa is expected to continue zigzagging in coming sessions with sharp movements in individual stock prices as players react to the results, they said.
The blue-chip IPSA index closed unofficially up 0.15 percent at 135.9 points. The general IGPA firmed 0.13 percent at 5,742.56 points.
Turnover rose slightly to 12.8 billion pesos from 12.5 billion pesos Friday.
Winners included drug-maker LabChile, which rose after reporting a sharp rise in second quarter profits last week, said traders.
"The results were really good. The company posted earnings nearly twice as high as in the same quarter last year," said one trader.
LabChile rallied 4.13 percent to 630 pesos. Its American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose 5.44 percent to 31-1/2.
The Chispa group of companies closed broadly lower after a spectacular run-up on rumors of the deal between Spanish utility Endesa and Enersis.
The stocks have fallen as investors now realise the offer by Endesa to buy the companies, which control Enersis, will only apply to shareholders owning the stocks on May 30, said traders.
Chispados fell 2.4 percent to 200 pesos. Almendros dropped to 199 pesos from 205 pesos.
